title: Evaluation bound for a covector at any tuple: |φ(v)| ≤ (Σ_β |dx^β(v)|)·|φ| (Step 4(a) of the parent proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let φ ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n be an n-covector on ℝ^P and let v : Fin n → Eucl P be an n-tuple of vectors of ℝ^P. Then |φ(v)| ≤ (Σ_{β ∈ I(n,P)} |dx^β(v)|)·|φ|. Here I(n,P) = SimonMultiIndex n P is the finite type of order embeddings Fin n ↪o Fin P, dx^β := wedgeCovectors n (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (β j)), and |φ| := covectorEuclideanNorm φ is Simon's Euclidean coefficient norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (φ : Covector (Eucl P) n) (v : Fin n → Eucl P), |φ v| ≤ (∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, |wedgeCovectors n (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.proj (β j) : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) v|) * covectorEuclideanNorm φ
